summary: chai-commerce is a direct-to-consumer storefront for loose-leaf chai built as a monorepo with three services: a Next.js web frontend, an Express REST API, and a BullMQ worker for asynchronous post-order jobs. The API handles authentication, product catalog, cart, orders, and Razorpay payments; the worker processes shipment creation and email receipts via Shiprocket and SendGrid.

nodes.label: Next.js Storefront
nodes.summary: Server-rendered Next.js 15 storefront with pages for product listing, detail, cart, checkout, login, and order history. Communicates with the API over HTTP and embeds Razorpay Checkout SDK in the browser.
details: Next.js 15 storefront with Server Components and Client Components
Razorpay Checkout SDK runs in browser with PUBLIC key only
Order payment status polled every 3 seconds via GET /api/orders/:id
OTP flow: client → /api/auth/otp → MSG91 SMS → /api/auth/verify → JWT stored in localStorage

nodes.label: Express REST API
nodes.summary: Central Express 5 REST API exposing auth, products, cart, orders, and payments routes. Uses JWT auth middleware, Zod validation, publishes jobs to BullMQ queue, and integrates Razorpay for payments.
details: Express 5 REST API with Zod validation
BullMQ queue for async jobs (order.created, shipment.created, send-receipt)
Central payment integration: Razorpay orders.create, webhook signature verification
JWT auth middleware protecting all routes

nodes.label: Authentication & OTP Service
nodes.summary: Handles user registration, login, JWT issuance, and OTP-based verification via MSG91 SMS. Protects API routes with bearer-token middleware.
details: Handles registration, login, JWT issuance, and OTP verification via MSG91 SMS
Bearer-token middleware protects API routes
OTP flow: POST /api/auth/otp → MSG91 SMS → user enters OTP → POST /api/auth/verify → JWT
Redis stores session sid for logout revocation

nodes.label: Product Catalog Service
nodes.summary: Manages product listings, variants, and inventory reads. Serves product data to the web frontend and validates stock during cart/checkout.
details: Manages product listings, variants, and inventory reads
Serves product data to web frontend and validates stock during cart/checkout
Uses PostgreSQL for data store

nodes.label: Cart Service
nodes.summary: Stores per-user cart state in Redis with TTL. Provides add, update, remove, and merge operations used during browsing and checkout.
details: Stores per-user cart state in Redis with TTL
Provides add, update, remove, and merge operations
Used during browsing and checkout flow

nodes.label: Orders Service
nodes.summary: Creates orders from validated carts, persists order items, calculates totals, and coordinates payment capture. Emits post-order jobs to the queue.
details: Creates orders from validated carts, persists order items, calculates totals
Coordinates payment capture
Emits post-order jobs to the queue (order.created / order.paid)
Order status polled from API by web frontend every 3 seconds

nodes.label: Payments Service (Razorpay)
nodes.summary: Creates Razorpay orders, verifies payment signatures, handles webhooks, and updates order payment status. Integrates UPI, cards, and netbanking.
details: Razorpay SDK: orders.create on order placement, payments.verified signature check on webhook
Webhook payload: razorpay_order_id + razorpay_signature HMAC-SHA256 verification against RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
Updates order payment status in PostgreSQL after verification
Integrates UPI, cards, and netbanking

nodes.label: BullMQ Worker
nodes.summary: Consumes jobs from Redis queue to create Shiprocket shipments and send order receipt emails via SendGrid. Runs as a separate process for reliability.
details: BullMQ Worker process consuming from order-queue
Two job types: createShipment (Shiprocket API) and sendReceipt (SendGrid email)
Runs as separate process for reliability; retries on failure
Dockerfile uses node:22-slim, installs @sendgrid/mail, bullmq, pg

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.summary: Primary relational store for products, variants, inventory, users, orders, order items, and payments. Initialized from db/schema.sql.
details: Primary relational store for: products, variants, inventory, users, orders, order items, payments
Schema initialized from db/schema.sql
pg pool used by API and worker processes
Tables include products, inventory, order_items, orders

nodes.label: Redis (Cache & Queue)
nodes.summary: Provides caching, session storage, OTP storage, cart persistence, and BullMQ job queue for async tasks.
details: Redis 7 serves multiple roles: session store, OTP cache, cart persistence (TTL), and BullMQ job queue backend
Key patterns: cart:{userId} with TTL, otp:{phone} with TTL, order-queue as BullMQ list
Provides caching, session storage, OTP storage, cart persistence with TTL
BullMQ job queue for async tasks

nodes.label: Razorpay Payment Gateway
nodes.summary: External payment provider for UPI, card, and netbanking payments. API creates orders and verifies signatures; web frontend renders checkout.
details: External payment gateway for UPI, card, and netbanking
Server-side: orders.create on checkout, webhook signature verification
Client-side: Razorpay Checkout SDK with PUBLIC key in browser

nodes.label: SendGrid Email
nodes.summary: Transactional email service used by the worker to send order receipt emails.
details: Transactional email service used by worker to send order receipt emails
SendGrid API call from worker job sendReceipt

Shiprocket API called from worker job createShipment
